'''2016 Worlds Day 3 Reid Smith DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Reid Smith]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
